question.text: If the tangent at the point $P$ with co-ordinates $(h, k)$ on the curve $y^{2}=2 x^{3}$ is perpendicular to the straight line $4 x=3 y$, then

solution.text:
$2 y \frac{d y}{d x}=6 x^{2} \Rightarrow \frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{3 x^{2}}{y}=-\frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow y=-4 x^{2}$ and $y^{2}=2 x^{3}$
$\Rightarrow 16 x^{4}=2 x^{3} \Rightarrow x=\frac{1}{8} \quad(x \neq 0)$
$y=\frac{-1}{16} \quad(y \neq 0)$
